subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should this PR be allowed to repair iMessage DM sender identity before access control only after canonical handle normalization and a fail-closed invariant are added?
rationale: The repaired sender becomes the authorization, pairing, session, and reply identity, so the permanent boundary cannot be decided safely from green unit tests or pre-fix logs alone.

options.title: Require canonical repair and proof
options.body: Require normalizeIMessageHandle-based comparisons, regression tests for formatted/service-prefixed handles, and redacted after-fix iMessage proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the narrower repair
options.body: Merge the direct payload repair without the broader fail-closed invariant and own the remaining identity-boundary uncertainty.

options.title: Pause until root cause is clearer
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it if the author's current failure proves to be a different iMessage root cause.

recommendation.title: Require canonical repair and proof
recommendation.body: Require normalizeIMessageHandle-based comparisons, regression tests for formatted/service-prefixed handles, and redacted after-fix iMessage proof before merge.
